plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and build cash.
Add to QQQI to increase income exposure.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and trimming concentration, accepting lower potential gains for lower drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to small positions.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration mandate.
Maintain CRWD at its current size, a strong performer.
Slightly trim QQQI to rebalance.
This plan balances risk reduction with continued growth potential.
balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for about 2.5% per month by reducing leverage and concentration while keeping exposure to quality names. It seeks risk-first growth, accepting moderate drawdowns for better upside.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to 6% each.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-scoring setups, including leveraged ETFs. Expect significantly higher potential gains and larger drawdowns due to leverage and daily rebalancing of leveraged products.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
